mapper.select: SELECT LMS_PRF_ID FROM LMS_PROFILE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT l.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, t.LEC_TIM_DAY_CODE AS lecTimDayCode, TO_CHAR(t.LEC_TIM_STR_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS lecTimStrTime, TO_CHAR(t.LEC_TIM_END_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS lecTimEndTime, TO_CHAR(s.SEM_STR_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS semStrDate, TO_CHAR(s.SEM_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS semEndDate FROM LECTURE_TIME t JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = t.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE l.LEC_VAL_STATUS != 'CNCL' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e WHERE e.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP') AND s.SEM_STR_DATE < TO_DATE(#{to}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND s.SEM_END_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{from}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

SELECT l.LEC_ID AS lecId, a.LEC_ASN_TITLE AS lecAsnTitle, TO_CHAR(a.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS lecAsnDueDate, TO_CHAR(a.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE, 'HH24:MI') AS lecAsnDueTime FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT a JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = a.LEC_ID WHERE l.LEC_VAL_STATUS != 'CNCL' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e WHERE e.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP') AND a.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{from}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND a.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE < TO_DATE(#{to}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
